scope: Immutable camera advances only after accepted native presentation; packet selection alone is not acknowledgement. Native smoke validates startup and present hook integration, not every physical display timing or pointer action.

cases: accepted and repeated presents retain the exact immutable camera()
older sequence and previous session generation cannot replace accepted state()
selected but rejected picture never becomes an input camera()
session close prevents late present from resurrecting an input camera()
accepted empty picture clears camera and blocks old session acknowledgement()
cleanup clears only the releasing scene selection()
failed acquire cannot leak its selection into a later nongame present()
scene cleanup invalidates queued acknowledgement but allows a recreated scene()
graphics pipelines use shared native cache and textures preflight before passes()
native memory deletion uses GPU fences instead of render frame counts()
MixedBuffer uploads use bytes while numeric buffers use elements()
failed native waits cannot be mistaken for completed GPU work()
presentation metrics only record returned presentation status()
texture transfers and lifecycle are installed in actual runtime classes()
mailbox consumption and rejected native present preserve acknowledged camera()
pointer down and release remain queued before the first accepted camera()

covered: Accepted/repeated camera preserves exact immutable state
Failed acquire candidate cleared before next UI-only frame
Old generation/sequence and released/closed tracker cannot overwrite accepted state
Null camera still queues pointer down/up with original coordinate fallback
limits: vkQueuePresent SUCCESS/SUBOPTIMAL is acceptance, not proof of physical scanout timing.
Original600-second interop evidence used earlier frozenv4; later display/input corrections have separate test/smoke evidence.
